notes: Energies are in eV, temperatures in K, and effective masses in units of the free-electron mass m0. Varshni alpha is in eV/K, not meV/K.

The supplied constants are an identifiable 2003 literature set, not a claim of current universal material values. InN gap estimates and alloy bowing depend on the selected literature and samples; edit values and provenance together when adopting another set.
Masses are interpolated linearly as a deliberate constant-parabolic-band approximation. Energy dependence, alloy disorder, excitons, strain and automatic polarization fields are not included.
The conduction-band offset ratio is a separate configurable model assumption in simulation.json, not a tabulated offset from these sources.
The electrostatic field is prescribed by the user along the growth coordinate; it is not inferred from orientation, doping or spontaneous/piezoelectric polarization.
